message: fix(email): center brand header via table layout
post:
The ApplyOS (applyos.io) email system has been a work in progress. Recently, we needed to refine the visual presentation of our emails, specifically the header.

The challenge was to ensure brand consistency across all email clients, which often have quirky rendering behaviors.

We landed on using an HTML table for the header layout. This approach provides reliable alignment and centering, even for older email clients that might struggle with modern CSS.

It's a reminder that sometimes the most robust solutions rely on older, well-understood patterns. What email rendering challenges have you faced?
alt: HTML table structure for centering a logo and brand name in an email header.
